objective_pt: Descrever a sua casa com "There is / There are", dizer os cômodos e onde as coisas estão (in, on, next to).

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer falando de onde o aluno mora: casa ou apartamento.
prompts: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
watchFor: Dizer "Have a sofa in my living room" (do "tem um sofá"); o certo é "There is a sofa".
Dizer "I live in a apartment"; antes de vogal é "an".

accepted: I live in an apartment
I live in a flat

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Antes de som de vogal usamos "an": "an apartment".

exercises.instruction_pt: Como dizemos "Tem um sofá na sala"?
options: There is a sofa in the living room.
Has a sofa in the living room.
It has a sofa in the living room.
exercises.explanation_pt: Para dizer que algo existe num lugar usamos "there is" (singular) ou "there are" (plural), não "has".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu moro numa casa."
accepted: I live in a house
I live in a home
I live in a big house
I live in a small house

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Morar numa casa" é "live in a house", com "in".
Para um fato do dia a dia use o presente simples: "I live".

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender cômodos e móveis: bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, living room, bed, table, chair, sofa, closet.
watchFor: Dizer "room" para quarto de dormir; o mais claro é "bedroom".

exercises.example_en: The kitchen is small but nice.
There are two bedrooms in my apartment.
We watch TV in the living room.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ligue cada palavra ao seu significado.
Diga em inglês: "Tem dois quartos no meu apartamento."
accepted: There are two bedrooms in my apartment
There are 2 bedrooms in my apartment
My apartment has two bedrooms
My apartment has 2 bedrooms
There are two bedrooms in my flat
My flat has two bedrooms
There are two rooms in my apartment

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tem" (existe) é "there is / there are". Ou diga "My apartment has...".
commonErrors.correction_en: There are two bedrooms in my apartment.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com plural usamos "there are": "There are two bedrooms".
commonErrors.correction_en: There are two bedrooms in my apartment.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar o "th" de "there" e diferenciar "kitchen" e "chicken".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. Língua entre os dentes no "th" de "there".
exercises.prompt: There is a table in the kitchen.
accepted: There is a table in the kitchen
There's a table in the kitchen

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Cuidado: "chicken" é frango. Cozinha é "kitchen" (começa com som de "k").
commonErrors.correction_en: There is a table in the kitchen.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "There are" se liga num som só: "theh-rar".
exercises.prompt: There are three chairs in the living room.
accepted: There are three chairs in the living room
There are 3 chairs in the living room

teacher.goal_pt: Entender uma descrição de casa e dizer onde as coisas estão.
prompts: Is there a garden in your house?
watchFor: Responder "Yes, have"; o certo é "Yes, there is".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha onde estão as chaves.
exercises.listen: Your keys are on the table, next to the lamp.
exercises.explanation_pt: Ele disse "on the table, next to the lamp": em cima da mesa, ao lado da luminária.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a pergunta e responda que sim, tem uma varanda.
exercises.listen: Is there a balcony in your apartment?
accepted: Yes, there is
Yes, there is a balcony
Yes, there's a balcony
Yes, there is one
Yes, it has a balcony
Yes, my apartment has a balcony
Yes, we have a balcony
Yes, I have a balcony
Yes, there is a small balcony
Yes

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para responder "Is there...?", diga "Yes, there is".
A pergunta é no singular ("Is there a balcony?"), então: "Yes, there is".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda: a TV está na sala.
accepted: It's in the living room
It is in the living room
In the living room
The TV is in the living room
It's in the lounge
It's in the living room, on the wall
In the living room, next to the sofa

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Dentro de um cômodo usamos "in": "in the living room".
Em inglês a frase precisa do sujeito: "It is in the living room".

teacher.goal_pt: Descrever a própria casa: tamanho, cômodos, o cômodo favorito e o que tem nele.
prompts: Where do you study or work at home?
watchFor: Esquecer o plural depois de números: "two bedroom".
Dizer "in the table" para "em cima da mesa"; o certo é "on".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "O meu quarto é pequeno, mas é confortável."
accepted: My bedroom is small, but it's comfortable
My bedroom is small but comfortable
My room is small, but it's comfortable
My room is small but comfortable
My bedroom is small, but it is very comfortable
My bedroom's small but it's comfortable
My bedroom is small but cozy

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês o sujeito não some: "but it's comfortable" (ou só "but comfortable").
commonErrors.correction_en: My bedroom is small, but it's comfortable.
My bedroom is small, but it's comfortable.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "O livro está em cima da mesa."
accepted: The book is on the table
The book's on the table
The book is on top of the table
The book is on the desk

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Em cima de" é "on": "on the table". "In" é dentro.
commonErrors.correction_en: The book is on the table.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Over" é acima sem encostar. Se o livro está apoiado, use "on".
commonErrors.correction_en: The book is on the table.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa para formar a pergunta.
accepted: How many rooms are there in your house

exercises.instruction_pt: Descreva a sua casa ou o seu apartamento.
exercises.prompt_en: I live in a small apartment with one bedroom and a nice kitchen. What about you? Tell me about your home.
guidelines_pt: Diga se é casa ou apartamento e se é grande ou pequeno.
Use "There is / There are" para os cômodos.
Fale do seu cômodo favorito e de 2 coisas que tem nele.

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar "there is/are", cômodos, móveis e as preposições in, on, next to.
prompts: What is next to your bed?
Is there a table in your kitchen?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Tem uma cadeira ao lado da cama."
accepted: There is a chair next to the bed
There's a chair next to the bed
There is a chair beside the bed
There's a chair by the bed
There is a chair by the bed
Next to the bed there is a chair

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para dizer que algo existe num lugar, use "there is".
commonErrors.correction_en: There is a chair next to the bed.
There is a chair next to the bed.

exercises.sentence: There ___ two sofas in the living room.
accepted: are

commonErrors.correction_en: There are two sofas in the living room.

exercises.instruction_pt: O gato está debaixo da cama. Qual preposição usamos?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Under" é debaixo: "The cat is under the bed".

accepted: Welcome to my home
Welcome to my house
